and ||p y - p x|| <= g^* ||y-x||, with upsilon_h = upsilon0 h^2 and upsilon0 K0 < g_*/2, prefix_average gives eq:prefix-average for every finite sequence theta_0..theta_J in Theta with the explicit constants C0 = 4 l0^2/a0, D1 = 2 + 2 l0^2/a0^2 (a0 = g_*/upsilon0 - K0/2, l0 = g^*/upsilon0 + K0), and prefix_selected gives eq:prefix-selected as ||E_h(theta_j*)|| <= sqrt(C0) h^-1 sqrt(D0/J) + sqrt(D1) (J^-1 sum ||b_j||^2)^{1/2} for a minimising index (the paper's C = max(sqrt C0, sqrt D1)). Chart-restricted Taylor/descent inequality eq:prefix-descent1 proved from scratch (descent_lower_on). The lattice-specific identification of the finite field chart and of ||.||_{0,h} with h^4 sum |v(x)|^2 is not encoded (E abstract).

cor:prefix-table.title: Finite-table certification for the prefix-balance entrance
cor:prefix-table.note: prefix_table_probability: on a probability space (Omega,P) carrying the accepted record theta_j : Omega -> E, a measurable safe event G on which the prefix stays in the chart (all hypotheses of thm:prefix-stationarity assumed on the chart), and integrable safe-indicated squared slopes/balances (finite tables), the probability that omega is unsafe or every observed slope exceeds h^alpha is <= P(G^c) + C0 D0/(J h^{2+2 alpha}) + D1 h^{-2 alpha} Q^bal with Q^bal = (1/J) sum_j E[1_G ||b_j||^2] (Markov's inequality on the safe-indicated pathwise average; holds for every real alpha, in particular 0 < alpha <= 1). eventually_certified_of_summable: the dyadic Borel-Cantelli clause (summable failure bounds on a common probability space => a.s. eventually certified, no independence). Disclosed: the fixed constant in the O(h^alpha) bound is taken as 1 (rescale h^alpha for another constant); D0 >= 0 assumed explicitly.

cor:generated-nonempty.title: Nonemptiness of the controlled finite class
cor:generated-nonempty.note: New version re-scoped (a separate comparison-action realization under the constrained-initial-solver hypotheses; no raw local-action budgets or source-drift claims). It composes prop:generated-initial (PROVED in this batch: ConstrainedInitialSolver.generated_initial / generated_initial_finite give the finite constrained initial data, unique conformal factor and the scalar component of eq:generated-initial-rate) with thm:generated-dynamics (still conditional_interface: the generic Galerkin / midpoint / Hermite machinery is proved, the H^q energy estimate for the quasilinear actual-jet system and the physical readouts are missing). Strict corollary policy: stays open while thm:generated-dynamics is open.
cor:generated-nonempty.plan: Closes when thm:generated-dynamics closes (see its plan): the corollary is the content of app:generated-dynamics = prop:generated-initial (proved) + thm:generated-dynamics; eq:generated-nonempty is eq:generated-first + eq:generated-bosonic, the Dirac clause is eq:generated-Dirac, and summable dyadic transport follows from the N^{-p} + tau rates along a dyadic cutoff family.

prop:component-reader.title: Assembly of full-reader bounds from component certificates
prop:component-reader.note: Proved for the reader tail τ_{h,m}(K;u) = Σ_{ℓ∈Λ,|ℓ|_∞>K}(1+|ℓ|₁/K)^m‖û(ℓ)‖ (SobolevReader.tail of Action/SobolevReaderCriterionExact.lean) and a finite block index β with blocks in arbitrary normed spaces F b. componentReader_assembly: if the tuple coefficient norm satisfies ‖û(ℓ)‖ ≤ κ Σ_b ‖û^{(b)}(ℓ)‖ (the fixed norm-equivalence constant κ ≥ 0 of the component norms, the paper's 'up to the fixed equivalence constants') and τ(u^{(b)}) ≤ t_b + c_b√V_b, then τ(u) ≤ κ(Σ_b t_b + (Σ_b c_b²)^{1/2}√V), V = Σ_b V_b. componentReader_assembly_euclidean: for the Euclidean block norm (u : Mode → PiLp 2 F) κ = 1 and eq:component-reader holds verbatim. Proof as in the paper: coefficient norm ≤ sum of block norms, nonnegative tail weights, Cauchy–Schwarz in the block index. Scoped hypothesis disclosed: V_b ≥ 0 (energies); c_b of any sign. The S(U(3)×U(2)) gauge-identification clauses are disclaimers, not formalized.

lem:native-firstjet-normal-form.title: Shifted-first-jet normal form of the unchanged local action
lem:native-firstjet-normal-form.note: Proved. (1) Curl decomposition of the plaquette logarithm: with L(z)=1+z L_1(z) (logQuotient_eq_one_add, L_1 an ofScalars series of radius 1) and Q=(a-b)+G(h;X,Y,ha,hb) (quotientPoly_eq_remQuotient), Phi(h;X,Y,a,b) = (a-b) + Rem(h;X,Y,ha,hb) on the logarithm chart ||h^2 Q||<1 (logPlaquette_eq_curl_add_rem), Rem jointly analytic near h=0 (analyticAt_remPlaquette). (2) eq:native-C-firstjet in algebraic form: det(e0+hp)-det e0 = h dqDet by row telescoping (det_add_smul_sub_det), (e0+hp)^{-1}-e0^{-1} = -h (e0+hp)^{-1} p e0^{-1}, hence C(e0+hp)-C(e0) = h dqPal(h;e0,p) for the antisymmetrised Palatini coefficient on the oriented chart (smul_dqPal_eq), dqPal smooth in (h,e0,p) where e0 and e0+hp are invertible (contDiffAt_dqPal) - no integral representation is needed. (3) eq:native-SBP in scalar form, periodic and on a sub-box with the exact collar (mul_fwdDiff_eq, sum_mul_fwdDiff, sum_mul_fwdDiff_box). (4) The normal form: localAction_eq_action_firstJetDensity: for h != 0 and every record on the oriented (det e(x)>0) logarithm chart (||P_{mu nu}(x)-1||<1 for the Cartan plaquette), S_h^loc[y] = ShiftedJetAction.action (firstJetDensity D (h,.)) h shiftVec y = h^4 sum_x F_h^(1)(Xi_h^(1) y(x)) exactly on the periodic grid (no collar), with F^(1) = firstJetDensity built from the normalised YM/Higgs/Dirac densities at (h,1) and the gravitational bulk gravFirstJet (Palatini contraction of antisym(Rem), cosmological term, and -sum dqPal(h; e(x-e_mu), delta^+ e(x-e_mu)) . omega_nu(x)); localAction_box_eq gives the sub-box form h^4 sum_{x in S} L = h^4 sum_{x in S} F^(1) + collar D h y S with the explicit collar functional, and collar_eq_layers shows the collar involves only the two boundary layers S \ (S-e_mu), (S-e_mu) \ S. (5) Regularity: contDiffAt_firstJetDensity (F^(1) is C^infty in (h, jet) at h=0 for jets in the chart JetChart = invertible coframes at the nine shifts) and exists_uniform_bound_firstJetDensity (for every order k and compact K of chart jets there are h0>0, C with F^(1) smooth at (h,xi) and all k-th derivatives bounded by C for |h|<=h0, xi in K). (6) Variational clause: localAction_eventuallyEq (the identity holds on a neighbourhood of y, the chart being open), fderiv_localAction_eq and iteratedFDeriv_localAction_eq (Euler covector and all mixed derivatives are those of the bulk representative). Renderings disclosed: the 'bounded nondegenerate coframe/logarithm chart' is rendered as det e(x) > 0 at every node (oriented) plus the plaquette log-chart condition; the stencil is over the nine shifts 0, +-e_mu; all representation-data/scoping conventions are those of NativeDensitiesExact (see lem:native-scaling).

lem:native-action-Hessian.title: Uniform upper Hessian scale of the local action
lem:native-action-Hessian.note: Proved as the corollary of the now-proved parent lem:native-firstjet-normal-form. exists_hessian_bounds: for every compact set K of shifted first jets inside the nondegenerate chart there are h0 > 0 and constants C1, K0, D0 (independent of h and of the number of nodes n; explicitly C1 = C2 * 9, K0 = 17 C2 * 9, D0 = 2 C0 with C2, C0 the uniform bounds of D^2 F^(1) and F^(1) on K) such that for 0 < h <= h0 and every record y on the oriented logarithm chart whose stencils Xi_h y(x) all lie in K: |D^2 S_h^loc(y)[u,v]| <= C1 ||u||_{1,h} ||v||_{1,h} (eq:action-Hessian-bilinear), |D^2 S_h^loc(y)[u,v]| <= K0 h^{-2} ||u||_{0,h} ||v||_{0,h} (eq:action-Hessian-scale, the mass-norm operator bound), and |S_h^loc(y) - S_h^loc(y')| <= D0 (h^4 n^4) for every second such record y' (eq:action-span, with the h^4 x number-of-cells volume factor as in the paper). The Hessian is that of the actual local action localAction D h (the density chain, including the coframe/spin-connection chain, is differentiated throughout): on the open chart S_h^loc coincides with the shifted-first-jet action (localAction_eventuallyEq), so its iterated derivatives are those of the bulk representative (iteratedFDeriv_localAction_eq), to which the local (ContDiffAt-along-the-record) chain rule iteratedFDeriv_action_of_contDiffAt and the bounds abs_iteratedFDeriv_action_le_of_contDiffAt / _mass_of_contDiffAt apply with M = C2 (via norm_iteratedFDeriv_partial_le, the jet-derivative of F^(1)(h,.) is bounded by the joint derivative); the oscillation uses ShiftedJetAction.abs_action_sub_le with B = C0. Renderings disclosed: the 'compact convex subchart with all shifted first-jet arguments in a common compact coefficient set' is rendered as the compact set K of jets in the chart together with the oriented log-chart conditions on the record; h0 <= 1 is taken from the compact chart (the mass bound uses h <= 1 as in the parent file); upper bounds only, no positivity is asserted.

prop:normal-source.title: Tangential stationarity and the missing normal row
prop:normal-source.note: Proved, on arbitrary real normed spaces X_h, Z_h, P (more general than the finite Hilbert space of the paper), with S_h : X_h → ℝ, C_h : X_h → Z_h, DS_h(x_h) = fderiv ℝ S x, DC_h(x_h) = fderiv ℝ C x, B_h a right inverse of DC_h(x_h) (surjectivity follows, constraintNormal_surjective), P_h = I − B_h DC_h (constraintNormalProjector) and a continuous linear lift I_h. normalSource_bound / normalSource_iSup_bound: under ‖P_h I_h v‖ ≤ L^tan, ‖DC_h I_h v‖ ≤ L^nor for ‖v‖ ≤ 1, |DS_h[w]| ≤ a_h‖w‖ on ker DC_h and |DS_h[B_h q]| ≤ b_h‖q‖, one has sup_{‖v‖≤1} |DS_h(x_h)[I_h v]| ≤ a_h L^tan + b_h L^nor (eq:normal-source-bound), via P_h w ∈ ker DC_h and w = P_h w + B_h DC_h w. normalSource_counterexample: S(x,y) = x² + y, C(x,y) = y — DS(0,0) vanishes on ker DC(0,0) (restricted stationarity) but DS(0,0)[(0,1)] = 1, the 'In particular' clause. Scoped hypotheses disclosed: a_h, b_h ≥ 0 (implicit constants of the covector bounds).

prop:constraint-extension.title: Residual-preserving extension of a constrained identity
prop:constraint-extension.note: Proved. Chart (s,c) ∈ E_s × E_c (real normed spaces), J : E_s × E_c → F C¹ into a complete normed space F (matrix-valued maps: F = matrices with any norm), D_cJ(s,c) = fderiv of c' ↦ J(s,c'). constraintExtension_ftc: eq:constraint-extension J(s,c) = J(s,0) + ∫₀¹ D_cJ(s,tc)[c] dt (FTC along the normal segment). constraintTracking: for ċ = A(t)c + r(t) on [0,T] with ∫₀ᵀ‖A‖ ≤ M and ‖c(0)‖ + ∫₀ᵀ‖r‖ ≤ C a^p, ‖c(t)‖ ≤ C e^M a^p for all t ∈ [0,T] (eq:constraint-tracking), from the Gronwall bound constraintTracking_le ‖c(t)‖ ≤ e^M(‖c(0)‖ + ∫₀ᵀ‖r‖), proved by an ε-perturbed comparison function e^{∫₀ᵗ‖A‖}(‖c(0)‖ + ε + ∫₀ᵗ‖r‖ + εt) and Mathlib's image_norm_le_of_norm_deriv_right_lt_deriv_boundary. constraintExtension_matrix_estimate: ‖D_cJ‖ ≤ L uniformly gives ‖J(s(t),c(t)) − J(s(t),0)‖ ≤ L·C e^M a^p on [0,T] (the O(a^p) matrix estimate). Scoped hypotheses disclosed: the tracking equation holds classically (c continuous on [0,T] with right derivative A(t)c(t) + r(t) on [0,T), A and r continuous on [0,T]) rather than in the Carathéodory/L¹ sense. The closing caveat (no estimate for an independent state-only source f(s,c); constant J counterexample) is commentary and not formalized.
